contract: Reserve command capacity before changing state or releasing a pending preparation reservation.
Install exact start_ms and normalized end_ms (positive unchanged, otherwise -1) into Snapshot before enqueue so the immutable Command has identical bounds.
Preserve operation/source/loop ownership, increment epoch exactly once and arm preparing/playing intent.
Require the still-active operation; no-operation, stopped and retired sessions cannot be resurrected.
Queue pressure leaves state, epoch, operation, queued offers, reservations and callback ownership unchanged. Caller retains active loop-pending state and may retry next pass.
No terminal callback, retirement or endpoint counter is emitted at this layer.
Previously exposed offers are not rewritten; successful new epoch makes old offers ineligible.
Generic seek keeps its existing end=-1 behavior. Manager loop must use loop_seek, not seek followed by snapshot-only set_end.
coverage: Exact source start/end in snapshot and queued command
Full-queue unchanged-state failure and successful next-pass retry after other-session progress
Outstanding preparation reservation survives failed loop admission
Single new epoch preserves operation and revokes old offers without rewriting them
Positive/nonpositive end normalization; generic seek behavior retained
Adapter callback ownership survives pressure/retry and remains single-delivery at later stop
